name: Misao Suzuhara
source:
“I’m so hopeless. I’m a bad teacher and a bad person…”

A young teacher straight out of university in Tokyo. Kind hearted and straight-laced, Misao struggles with her new role realising that she lacks the real world experience needed to help her students through their last year of schooling.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=37532]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
